sections.title: Future, live
sections.intro: The 2016 Future cluster: a chrome dial, the song that's playing, missed calls and messages. This is the real wallpaper, drawn in your browser by the app's own code. Tap the big gauge, and try Future's layouts and colours.

qr.alt: A QR code that opens Speedometer Live Wallpaper on Google Play

labels.screen: Speedometer Live Wallpaper, live: tap the big gauge to switch it
labels.gauge: Tap the big gauge to switch between power, CPU clock and speed, as on your phone.
labels.getNote: A browser can’t set your wallpaper. Get the app on Google Play, open Styles and pick this one.

sections.title: About Future
sections.intro: Future is the other style from 2016: a chrome dial in a cluster that also shows the song that's playing, its cover and the volume, and your missed calls and unread messages. Those need notification access, and nothing it reads leaves your phone.

items.alt: The Future style, as the wallpaper draws it
items.caption: Future, drawn by the app itself

items.title: €2.39, once
items.text: Buy Future once on Google Play and it's yours. On a new phone with the same Google account, it comes back by itself.

items.title: One dial, three jobs
items.text: The big gauge shows power, CPU clock or GPS speed. Tap it on your home screen to switch, as in every style.

items.title: Make it yours
items.text: Customize sets Future's colours and background, and its units, clock and warning lights.

items.title: Layouts, and your own
items.text: Most styles come in several layouts. You can also drag and resize the gauges and save your own.

sections.title: More styles
sections.intro: Every style runs live on its own page. Or try them all in your browser.
